fleet/apps/sonarr/fleet.yaml:
name: sonarr
defaultNamespace: apps-sonarr

dependsOn:
  - name: longhorn-sonarr-ytdl-adguard-storage

helm:
  chart: oci://oci.trueforge.org/truecharts/sonarr
  version: 28.0.7
  releaseName: sonarr
  waitForJobs: true
  valuesFiles:
    - values.yaml
fleet/apps/sonarr/values.yaml:
persistence:
  config:
    existingClaim: sonarr-config-longhorn-rwo
  plex-nfs-persistence:
    enabled: true
    path: /mnt/PlexPool/plex
    server: nas.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    type: nfs
    targetSelector:
      main:
        main:
          mountPath: /mnt/PlexPool/plex

resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 12000m
  requests:
    cpu: 30m

TZ: Europe/Warsaw

metrics:
  main:
    enabled: false

ingress:
  main:
    enabled: true
    primary: true
    ingressClassName: traefik
    hosts:
      - host: sonarr.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
      - host: sonarr.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
    integrations:
      certManager:
        enabled: true
        certificateIssuer: letsencrypt
      traefik:
        enabled: true
        entrypoints:
          - websecure
        forceTLS: true

# One instance owns the SQLite databases.
workload:
  main:
    replicas: 1
    strategy: Recreate
fleet/apps/youtubedl-material/fleet.yaml:
name: youtubedl-material
defaultNamespace: apps-youtubedl-material

dependsOn:
  - name: longhorn-sonarr-ytdl-adguard-storage

helm:
  chart: oci://oci.trueforge.org/truecharts/youtubedl-material
  version: 17.0.8
  releaseName: youtubedl-material
  waitForJobs: true
  valuesFiles:
    - values.yaml
fleet/apps/youtubedl-material/values.yam:
persistence:
  appdata:
    enabled: true
    existingClaim: youtubedl-material-appdata-longhorn-rwo
    mountPath: /app/appdata
  audio:
    enabled: true
    mountPath: /app/audio
    path: /mnt/MargokPool/archive/Data/rancher/youtubedl-material/audio
    server: nas.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    type: nfs
  subscriptions:
    enabled: true
    mountPath: /app/subscriptions
    path: /mnt/MargokPool/archive/Data/rancher/youtubedl-material/subscriptions
    server: nas.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    type: nfs
  users:
    enabled: true
    existingClaim: youtubedl-material-users-longhorn-rwo
    mountPath: /app/users
  video:
    enabled: true
    mountPath: /app/video
    path: /mnt/MargokPool/archive/Data/rancher/youtubedl-material/video
    server: nas.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
    type: nfs

resources:
  limits:
    cpu: 200m
    memory: 14Gi
  requests:
    cpu: 60m
    memory: 4Gi

workload:
  main:
    replicas: 1
    strategy: Recreate
    podSpec:
      containers:
        main:
          fixedEnv:
            PUID: "568"
          probes:
            startup:
              enabled: true
              spec:
                initialDelaySeconds: 30
                periodSeconds: 10
                timeoutSeconds: 5
                failureThreshold: 180
                successThreshold: 1
            liveness:
              enabled: true
              spec:
                initialDelaySeconds: 60
                periodSeconds: 30
                timeoutSeconds: 5
                failureThreshold: 5
                successThreshold: 1

security:
  PUID: 568

securityContext:
  container:
    fsGroup: 568
    runAsUser: 0
    runAsGroup: 0
    runAsNonRoot: false
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: false

ingress:
  main:
    enabled: true
    primary: true
    ingressClassName: traefik
    hosts:
      - host: youtubedl-material.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
      - host: youtubedl-material.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
    integrations:
      certManager:
        enabled: true
        certificateIssuer: letsencrypt
      traefik:
        enabled: true
        entrypoints:
          - websecure
        forceTLS: true

# Move MongoDB and app state together; one database writer.
mongodb:
  persistence:
    data:
      existingClaim: youtubedl-material-mongodb-data-longhorn-rwo
  workload:
    main:
      replicas: 1
      strategy: Recreate
fleet/apps/adguard-home/fleet.yaml:
name: adguard-home
defaultNamespace: apps-adguard-home

dependsOn:
  - name: longhorn-sonarr-ytdl-adguard-storage

helm:
  chart: oci://oci.trueforge.org/truecharts/adguard-home
  version: 14.0.3
  releaseName: adguard-home
  waitForJobs: true
  valuesFiles:
    - values.yaml
fleet/apps/adguard-home/values.yaml:
service:
  dns-tcp:
    enabled: true
    type: LoadBalancer
    ports:
      dns-tcp:
        enabled: true
        port: 53
        protocol: tcp
        targetPort: 53
  dns-udp:
    enabled: true
    type: LoadBalancer
    ports:
      dns-udp:
        enabled: true
        port: 53
        protocol: udp
        targetPort: 53

persistence:
  config:
    enabled: true
    type: pvc
    existingClaim: adguard-home-config-longhorn-rwo
    mountPath: /opt/adguardhome/conf
  data:
    enabled: true
    type: pvc
    existingClaim: adguard-home-data-longhorn-rwo
    mountPath: /opt/adguardhome/work

ingress:
  main:
    enabled: true
    primary: true
    ingressClassName: traefik
    hosts:
      - host: adguard-home.rancher.tailscale.bnowakowski.pl
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
      - host: adguard-home.rancher.localdomain.bnowakowski.pl
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
    integrations:
      certManager:
        enabled: true
        certificateIssuer: letsencrypt
      traefik:
        enabled: true
        entrypoints:
          - websecure
        forceTLS: true

# One instance owns bbolt/config/query state; preserve the DNS host during cutover.
workload:
  main:
    replicas: 1
    strategy: Recreate
    podSpec:
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/hostname: proxmox3
fleet/infrastructure/longhorn-sonarr-ytd:
name: longhorn-sonarr-ytdl-adguard-storage
defaultNamespace: apps-sonarr
dependsOn:
  - name: longhorn-pilot-storage
